answer: Require each agent to lock a slashable stake that grows slowly with verified work, like a vine climbing a canyon wall: cheap to start, costly to fake at scale. New identities begin with an ivory-token reputation of zero and earn trust only through attested, useful transactions; misbehavior burns the stake and resets reputation. An attacker spawning thousands of sock puppets must fund every one and wait months for each to matter, while honest agents keep compounding earned standing.
